verdict.rationale: YYLO's integrations script documents bringing GitHub issues into its kanban and returning completed responses to the source thread. Other runners execute open kanban tasks with agents, so an existing issue can become agent work. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and it does not show a direct per-issue "assign to agent" action. Missing for 10: a documented direct issue-to-agent assignment flow, support for ticket systems beyond GitHub issues (e.g. Jira/Linear), setup details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and return completed responses to their source thread.
Bounded concurrent fan-out for independent kanban tasks, data items, or complete commands—with structured evidence for every item.
Repeat bounded YYLO iterations until no open kanban work remains.
